items.text: Skinny & Franko: Fists of Violence – Hotfix Update to version 2.0.2
Newest update focuses on fixing gameplay issues, and stability problems reported after version 2.0.1 went live.
Fixed an issue where enemies stayed on screen after defeating the Stage 2 boss and driving the car.
Fixed an issue where player could go too far to the left after defeating the Stage 2 boss and driving the car.: Stability
General gameplay and progression stability improvements.: Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and shared feedback.: Your reports help us keep Skinny & Franko running smoothly!
Skinny & Franko: Fists of Violence – Hotfix Update on version 2.0.0
Newest update focuses on fixing several progression blockers, gameplay issues, and stability problems reported after version 2.0.0 went live.
Fixed an issue where enemy behavior becomes incorrect after defeating the Stage 2 boss.
Fixed a rare game freeze that could occur on Stage 3 after defeating Gypsy.
Fixed a progression blocker that could occur on Stage 8 shortly before the final boss encounter.
Fixed an issue with a Stage 2 enemy occasionally walking backwards.
Fixed an input lock issue that could occur when attacking the Stage 2 boss's henchmen too fast.
Fixed the displayed game version number in the main menu.: Stability

General gameplay and progression stability improvements with some added safeguards.: Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and shared feedback.: Your reports help us keep Skinny & Franko running smoothly!
